# Vexaris

> Self-hosted e-commerce infrastructure for selling digital products. List products, accept payments, and deliver automatically — all from one panel.

Vexaris is free, self-hosted software for selling digital goods: e-pins, license keys, software packages, Minecraft plugins, server setups, e-books and downloadable files. Sellers apply for access; approved accounts receive the product, a license key, and panel access.

- Homepage: https://vexaris.com.tr/
- Features: https://vexaris.com.tr/features
- Pricing: https://vexaris.com.tr/pricing (Free $0, Starter $6.99, Professional $14.99, Enterprise $39.99; yearly billing −20%)
- Blog: https://vexaris.com.tr/blog
- License check: https://vexaris.com.tr/license-check
- Demo: https://demo.vexaris.com.tr
- Status: https://status.vexaris.com.tr

## How it works

1. Publish your product: upload zip/rar/7z/jar files or paste one-per-line e-pins and license keys. Price, discount, category and ordering in a single form.
2. Customer checks out: cart, coupons, balance or card payment with silent Turnstile verification.
3. System delivers: the second payment is approved, a stock line is pulled, the license key is signed, and files land in the customer's library. Average delivery time: 0.4 seconds.
4. Support and updates: tickets, new versions and download lists are built in.

## Payments

9 payment and sales integrations: Shopier, PayTR, iyzico, Stripe, PayPal, BitPay, Cryptomus, Paywant and Whop. Crypto, installments, 3D Secure, saved cards, IPN/webhook approval. Card details never touch Vexaris servers.

## Store modules

- Product & stock management (unlimited and single-stock modes; sales auto-close when stock runs out)
- Coupons & balance (percentage/gift coupons, wallet payments, refunds to balance)
- Support tickets (categories, priorities, messaging, history)
- Roles & permissions (admin, manager, moderator, support team)
- Themes (default, azure, ember) and integrations (social login, captcha, live support)
- Mail templates & SEO (customizable transactional mails, titles, descriptions, OG tags)
- Blog, announcements, FAQ, reviews, licenses, version tracking, applications
- Maintenance mode, scheduled publishing, categories, sliders, download tokens

## Accounts and access

- Registration is open; seller applications are reviewed within 24 hours.
- Sign-in supports email/password plus Google, Discord, GitHub and Microsoft OAuth.
- Forgot-password flow uses a 6-digit emailed code; sessions can be managed per device.
- Free plan: application-based, limited products, x.vexaris.com.tr subdomain.

## Licensing

Each install is bound to licensed domains (subdomains included) with online verification. License status can be checked at https://vexaris.com.tr/license-check. Self-host setup is available on special request; standard use runs on Vexaris SaaS infrastructure hosted abroad.

## Support

- Support tickets and Discord notifications with webhooks
- Contact: info@vexaris.com.tr
- Docs and updates ship through the in-panel blog and changelog
